Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: X.400 address type confusion in X.509 GeneralName
Vulnerabilities.Description: There is a type confusion vulnerability relating to X.400 address processing inside an X.509 GeneralName. X.400 addresses were parsed as an ASN1_STRING but the public structure definition for GENERAL_NAME incorrectly specified the type of the x400Address field as ASN1_TYPE.

Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: double free after calling PEM_read_bio_ex
Vulnerabilities.Description: The function PEM_read_bio_ex() reads a PEM file from a BIO and parses and decodes the name and header. The header may optionally be followed by additional text.

Vulnerabilities.Title: PyYAML: arbitrary code execution through python/object/apply constructor
Vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability was discovered in the PyYAML library in versions before 5.4.
